target: Custom temporal-event instrument compiler, producing reference traces, synthesizable RTL and a finite functional acceptance dossier
scope: Primary-source tool and prior-art evidence; no physical hardware, SDK integration, synthesis run or measurement executed by this source workstream.

sources.title: YoWASP Yosys
sources.summary: WebAssembly build of Yosys packaged for Python; ISC license. Current opened page showed 0.70 despite stale search snippet showing 0.69.
sources.limits: All transitive dependency versions and hashes must also be locked from the actual installation. Package inspection is not evidence it ran locally.

sources.title: Amaranth HDL
sources.summary: Python HDL with simulator, build system and Verilog integration. Official installation supports builtin-yosys extra.
sources.limits: Development docs say 0.6.0.dev; PyPI's accidental 0.6.0 release is yanked. Pin a deliberate released version.

sources.title: Amaranth simulator
sources.summary: Simulates elaborated synchronous logic; add_testbench receives SimulatorContext with set/get/tick. Can record VCD and reset a simulator to amortize startup.
sources.limits: Functional RTL simulation does not establish place-and-route timing, power, data-link compatibility or board operation.

sources.title: Yosys equivalence checking commands
sources.summary: equiv_make, equiv_simple and equiv_status support equivalence-check workflows. equiv_simple uses SAT; sequence depth and assumptions affect scope.
sources.limits: A bounded proof is not unbounded correctness. Report exact command, assumptions, reset semantics, proof status and depth; do not equate synthesis success with equivalence.

sources.title: Swabian Conditional Filter
sources.summary: Existing device-level hardware filter passes the next filtered event after a trigger. Documentation says independent trigger/filter groups cannot be configured separately; simultaneous trigger/filter behavior is unspecified.
sources.inference: Multiple independent temporal sequence/veto contracts with explicit same-tick semantics define a candidate gap beyond the built-in filter.
sources.limits: This gap is not unique scientific novelty or verified customer demand. The vendor offers custom software and FPGA alternatives.

sources.title: Swabian raw time-tag stream access
sources.summary: TimeTagStream and CustomMeasurement support processing raw data; Time Tagger Virtual supports replay using the full API.
sources.inference: The practical alternative is a competent current-AI-assisted SDK implementation; for offline decisions a simple software oracle may satisfy the entire buyer need.
sources.limits: Availability of an SDK does not imply the study has the vendor binaries, hardware or authorization; standalone replay must be labeled compatible only with its own specified schema.

sources.title: Swabian FPGA Link
sources.summary: Time Tagger X can stream via Ethernet to an external FPGA for higher rate/lower latency than USB. Reference design and wire format are unstable; no retransmission; QSFP+ example needs licensed Xilinx IP.
sources.inference: A reusable temporal core could eventually plug into an adapter, but that interface is an unbuilt separate integration milestone.
sources.limits: Do not claim board compatibility, data-loss tolerance, achievable clock rate or real-time latency from generated RTL alone.

sources.title: Swabian FPGA reference design
sources.summary: Vendor supplies a reference FPGA link design and instructions for modification.
sources.limits: This source is material prior art and a potential integration target, not code that this campaign has reused or validated.

recommended_contract.input: A normalized clock-tick stream with explicitly allowed simultaneous channel events; separate clock, reset and valid semantics.
semantics: Define whether a start event resets an existing window or permits overlap.
Define inclusive/exclusive minimum and maximum delay boundaries.
Give veto/reset explicit priority over acceptance.
Specify overflow, out-of-order events, timestamp wrap and dropped-event handling.
Specify pulse length and whether multiple predicates can fire on the same tick.
recommended_contract.acceptance: Independent specification oracle versus actual RTL simulator on exhaustive small traces plus fresh seeded longer traces; include deliberately mutated designs to test rejection. Synthesis and formal checks are additional gates with exact limits.
recommended_contract.strongest_comparator: A separate AI-assisted engineer writes conventional FSM/HDL or SDK processing with the same specification, resources and acceptance oracle. Library reuse is included because it is ordinary competence.
recommended_contract.successor: Fresh mission adds independent predicates or a different temporal pattern. Compare retained compiler/core with a baseline and an ordinary library of the same components; charge validation/integration/upkeep.
recommended_contract.frontier_causality: The documented gap predates October 2026. A recent model release may reduce construction cost, but without a historical controlled comparison this study establishes a candidate newly economic route, not that no earlier team could have built it.
